difficulty_reason: Comparison H^0(f^!O_X) = omega_{Y/X} for quasi-finite separated Noetherian maps: via Zariski main theorem factorization f' finite, the twisted inverse image lemmas identify a'(O_X) up to H^0 with RHom(f'_*O_{Y'}, O_X), the affine module equivalence gives H^0(V', a'(O_X)) = Hom_A(B', A), and restriction to V is omega = Hom_A(B', A) tensor_{B'} B; restriction-map compatibility checked against the localize-dualizing lemma. Retained author proof at lines 3377-3431.
